title: The Fortieth Verse
summary: Mother Coke will teach a shaman of yours the fortieth verse, the one that stops rhyming. It wants singing over the clans' own ore, in the Assay Yards' sheds.

steps.journal: The Assay Yards, the first floor or below: hold six waves.

objectives.label: Waves held in the Assay Yards

ready: The verse is sung over the clans' ore. Tell Mother Coke.
done: Your shamans know the fortieth verse. Mother Coke says they sing it flat.
